summary.text: The story takes place on Dominaria after the Sylex Blast ends the Brothers' War and begins the Ice Age, when Lim-Dûl unleashes a horde of undead and forces old enemies to work together.

It follows Jodah, Jaya Ballard and the Kjeldoran king Darien, who ally with the Balduvians against the necromancer and defeat his plots, while Freyalise, a planeswalker who has been fatally struck in a duel, fights Szat to protect the plane.
At the end of the Ice Age, Freyalise casts the World Spell to break the enchantments that caused it, though the spell warms the continents and floods Terisiare.
